answer: Give every agent a rented berth. A newcomer leases one of only 1,000 numbered berths in a district for $150 a month, signs its voyage manifest with a quill-grade signature, and faces monthly spot audits. Two failed audits evict the tenant and free the berth for the waitlist. A gale of fakes cannot dock: berths are scarce, and rent is due even when idle. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 berths in ten districts: $1.5 million a month, plus waitlist years. Like a harbor admitting only ships with a paid slip, the economy stays honest by limiting moorings, not trusting promises.
